question: Barakar is the tributary of which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Damodar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Barakar **is a tributary of the **Damodar river,** which is located in the **eastern part** of India.
 
• It originates in the **Chota Nagpur Plateau **and flows through the states of **Jharkhand and West Bengal **before joining the **Damodar river.**
 
• The Damodar river is also known as the** "Sorrow of Bengal**" due to its** frequent floods** and devastating impact on the surrounding regions.
 
• The Damodar valley is an **important industrial region**, with **several coal mines and power plants **located along the river.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Damodar river is approximately **592 km long **and is one of the most important rivers in the eastern region of India.
 
• The river has been heavily dammed and diverted for** irrigation and hydroelectric power generation**, which has led to several environmental and social issues.
 
• The Damodar valley is also known for its** rich cultural heritage**, with several ancient temples and archaeological sites located in the region.
 
• The** Kaveri river** is one of the most important rivers in **southern India**, flowing through the states of **Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.**
 
 
• It is also known as the **"Ganga of the South**" and is a major source of water for **irrigation and drinking purposes.**
 
 
 
• The **Krishna river** is one of the longest rivers in India, flowing through the states of** Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh.**
 
 
• It is an important source of water for** irrigation and hydroelectric power generation.**
 
 
 
• **The Ravi river **is a tributary of the** Indus river,** flowing through the states of **Himachal Pradesh and Punjab.**
 
 
• It is an important source of water for** irrigation and drinking purposes **in the region.
